audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike was stated with a 25% execute number and no range or cooldown on Fear Beyond Death.
audit.why: Riot's text gives an unnumbered threshold; the R is 100/85/70s at 2500 range, which is what actually beats a champion whose plan is to run.
audit.corrected: Fear Beyond Death is 100s at rank 1 and reaches 2500 units — it catches a fleeing Singed from across the screen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Mega Adhesive grounds, and never gives Fling's range or cooldown.
audit.why: Riot kit: Mega Adhesive (17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range) slows and grounds enemies who walk on it — grounding shuts off Disdain, your only escape. Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 125 range, and a target flung into the adhesive is rooted as well. Insanity Potion (100s) makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so your own healing is cut during his ult.
audit.corrected: Fling only reaches 125 units — space outside it. If he lands you in Mega Adhesive you are rooted and grounded, and Disdain will not fire.
